summary.name: Serplux
summary.one_liner: Serplux is an AI SEO platform with automated agents for keyword tracking, content ideas, competitor analysis, and site audits, plus an AI search visibility tracker listed as coming soon.
use_cases: generate blog topic ideas based on trending searches
track brand visibility in AI Overviews and AI answers
summary.what_it_does: Serplux offers AI agents that run SEO tasks: an SEO strategy agent that analyzes a site, competitors and market to produce a roadmap, a keyword position tracker that tracks keywords on Google with position updates every 24 hours, and a competition analysis agent that monitors competitor keywords and backlinks. Content agents generate blog topic ideas (the page claims 50+ per week), and a UX review agent scans site structure for SEO issues and suggests fixes. The page also lists custom agents for niches such as e-commerce, local business and SaaS, offered after a consultation. An AI Search Tracker and a Site Audit Agent are listed as coming Q1 2026.
notable: AI agents that run SEO tasks 24/7 including keyword tracking, competitor monitoring and site audits
Comparison table against Ubersuggest and Nightwatch claiming AI strategy, content ideas and UX audit features
Custom AI agent builds for specific niches on request
caveats: Page advertises a free forever plan but does not detail its limits; paid tiers are not described
AI Search Tracker and Site Audit Agent are listed as coming Q1 2026, so not yet available per the page
Performance and traffic claims (such as 15 hours/week recovered and average traffic increase) are marketing statements without stated methodology
